title: Thrushwell recalls the Pulse 3 smartwatch over swelling batteries
notes: Launch Desk's Pulse 4 article is grouped here on purpose, so the demo can show X.

facts.f01: Thrushwell is recalling its Pulse 3 smartwatch
facts.f02: Its battery can swell and push the screen out
facts.f04: Owners should stop using it right away
facts.f06: The faulty cells came from a single supplier
facts.f07: Only watches made from March to June 2025 are affected
facts.f08: The cells' separator film was thinner than specified
facts.f09: A software update puts a recall alert on the watch
facts.f10: The safety office has 37 reports of swelling batteries
facts.f16: The Pulse 4's battery lasts up to 4 days

byteward.title: Thrushwell recalls the Pulse 3 smartwatch over swelling batteries
byteward.author: Arlo Pennick
body: [f01: Thrushwell is recalling its Pulse 3 smartwatch, the company announced today.] [f02: It says the watch's battery can swell and push the screen out of the case.]
[f03: About 410,000 watches are covered by the recall.] [f04: Thrushwell is telling owners to stop using the watch right away.]

[f05: Owners who return the watch will get a full refund.] It's an expensive mistake, and owners will want to know how a fault like this got past testing. Thrushwell will be hoping the news doesn't follow it into the holiday season.

ohm-and-bit.title: Thrushwell recalls its Pulse 3 smartwatch over swelling batteries
ohm-and-bit.author: Imogen Vale
body: [f02: The Pulse 3's problem is a battery that can swell until it pushes the screen out.] Swelling happens when gas builds up inside a lithium cell, usually because something inside it is breaking down.
[f06: Thrushwell traced the faulty cells to a single supplier.] [f08: In those cells, the separator, the thin film that keeps the electrodes apart, was thinner than specified.]
[f07: Only watches made between March and June 2025 are affected.] [f03: That still adds up to about 410,000 watches.]
[f09: Thrushwell is also pushing a software update that puts a recall alert on affected watches.] That's a sensible step, since plenty of owners will never read an email about it.

bench-and-bill.title: Thrushwell recalls the Pulse 3 smartwatch, citing swelling batteries
bench-and-bill.author: Celia Marchetti
body: [f01: The Consumer Device Safety Office today posted Thrushwell's recall of its Pulse 3 smartwatch.] [f10: According to the notice, the office has received 37 reports of batteries swelling.] [f11: Four people reported minor burns.]
[f07: The recall covers only watches made between March and June 2025.] [f12: They were sold from April 2025 through October 2026.]
[f05: Owners are entitled to a full refund.] They shouldn't wait to claim it.

wirefold.title: Thrushwell recalls Pulse 3 smartwatches over battery swelling
body: Thrushwell is recalling about 410,000 Pulse 3 smartwatches because their batteries can swell and push the screen out, the company said.

launch-desk.title: Thrushwell unveils the Pulse 4 smartwatch
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f13: Thrushwell has unveiled the Pulse 4, its next smartwatch.] [f14: It costs $299.] [f15: It ships December 3.]

[f16: Thrushwell says the battery lasts up to four days on a charge.] That's the number Thrushwell wants buyers to remember. At that price, the Pulse 4 lands in the middle of the premium watch market, where battery life is still the easiest way to stand out.
